title: Success Rates for Assisted Reproductive Technology Treatments at Public Hospitals
what_it_is: Success Rates for Assisted Reproductive Technology Treatments at Public Hospitals

sections.label: ART success rates public private
sections.summary: The success rate for ART at public AR centres is higher than private, but the difference is within 10%, so the rates are comparable.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: [Please refer to ​"Statistics on Assisted Reproductive Technology Success Rate for Public and Private Centres", Official Report, 10 January 2024, Vol 95, Issue 119, Written Answers to Questions section.] The success rate for ART at public AR centres is higher than that in private AR centres.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: But the difference in ART success rates is within 10%.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Hence, as explained previously, the success rates of public and private AR centres are comparable.

sections.label: Subsidy extension to private centres
sections.summary: The data is not on hand, and the study on extending subsidies to private AR centres is ongoing with no timeframe yet.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: With regard to the Member's first supplementary question, I do not have the data on hand.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: On the issue of extension of subsidies to the private AR centres, we are still in the midst of studying this.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We do not have the timeframe yet and we will update the Member when the information is available.
